identity: The mirror hostname is ignored; /board/src/thread/file identifies a clip.

policy.confirmed_positive: User explicitly confirmed the clip as a screamer.
policy.confirmed_visual_only_screamer: User confirmed a visual jump-scare whose audio is not expected to identify it; excluded from audio-detector recall.
policy.reviewed_negative: User listened to the clip and described it as legitimate/non-screamer content.
policy.provisional_negative: Attachments in an explicitly reviewed thread that were not labeled as screamers are treated as high-confidence negatives, but can be relabeled later.
policy.unlabeled: Retained for future review or training, but must not be counted as either class until the user labels it.
policy.reviewed_ambiguous: User-reviewed borderline audio (for example, a loud meme). Retained with the user's description but resolves to unlabeled for binary training/evaluation; overrides whole-thread negative labels and does not force a browser score.
